findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice long questions for Chapter 12 in the same format as the Physics chapter practice, long questions in the Chemistry Board shape (4 marks each) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 23 questions numbered 1-23; by section: u-nitrogen 1, 12.1 1, 12.2.2 1, 12.2.3 1, 12.3 1, 12.5.1 1, 12.6 1, 12.7 1, 12.8.1 1, 12.9 2, 12.10 1, 12.11.3 1, 12.12 1, 12.13.1 4, 12.13.2 1, 12.13.3 3, 12.13.4 1.

Theory parts cover nitrogen and the inertness of N₂, structures of NH₃/NH₄⁺, oxides of nitrogen, NOₓ sources and smog, the catalytic converter reactions, nitrification and denitrification, sulfur (properties, catenation, oxidation states), the Frost diagram, reactions and uses of sulfur, organic sulfur compounds, the contact process, and the structure, properties, acid-base and redox chemistry and uses of sulphuric acid. Numericals (N₂ from NH₄NO₂, NH₃ from NH₄Cl, gunpowder, heat of burning S and of SO₂ → SO₃, oleum, Frost-diagram ΔG°, Cu + hot conc. H₂SO₄) use changed amounts with molar masses given in the questions, recomputed in Python. None repeats exercise Q.3-Q.6. Book corrections followed (balanced equations, FeS₂, V₂O₅ → V₂O₄, Pt/Rh, NO = 11 electrons, gypsum CaSO₄·2H₂O, ethene gas).
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
